## Overview On ROCm the gated RMSNorm of Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5-family GDN layers (`RMSNormGated`) compiles to two Inductor kernels per layer because `rms_norm_gated` is off in the default `custom_ops`, and the existing FLA path (`rmsnorm_fn`) is not a registered op that `torch.compile` can trace. This PR wraps that call in a custom op (`vllm.fla_rms_norm_gated`) and enables it by default on ROCm for unquantized models (quantized models keep the original kernels; `-rms_norm_gated` opts out). One Triton launch replaces two. ## Claims Before: After: ## Validation ```bash # Serve vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \ --language-model-only --no-enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --async-scheduling # Bench vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 # Accuracy lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False ``` > [!NOTE] > Run on MI355X against the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-09-22 (vLLM 0961bbae28, torch 2.12 / amd-aiter 0.1.22.post1). ### Benchmark | Concurrency | Version | Output token throughput (tok/s) | Change | Median (48 linear-attention layers): | step | before (native decomposition) | after | Δ per layer | |---|---|---|---| | decode (64 tokens) | `triton_per_fused_…_rsqrt_silu_view_2` 4.4 µs +
